title: PV Sindhu, Ayush Shetty Exit China Open Super 1000 After Wasting Match Points
indian_angle: This story is important for Indian fans as it details the recent performance and exit of two prominent Indian shuttlers from a prestigious Super 1000 tournament.
summary: PV Sindhu and Ayush Shetty both exited the China Open Super 1000 after failing to convert match points in their respective matches. Sindhu lost to Chen Yufei, while Shetty also faced defeat.

title: PV Sindhu Claims Japan Open Title with Dominant Win Over Akane Yamaguchi
indian_angle: This is a major victory for India, with PV Sindhu winning a Super 750 title, signifying her return to top form and boosting national pride.
summary: PV Sindhu secured her maiden Japan Open title with a dominant victory over local favourite Akane Yamaguchi, ending a significant title drought and marking a strong comeback.

title: Rising Star Ayush Shetty Defeats Alwi Farhan at China Open
indian_angle: Indian fans will be keen to follow the progress of rising star Ayush Shetty, whose victory against a strong opponent signals a bright future for Indian badminton.
summary: Young Indian shuttler Ayush Shetty showcased his potential by defeating Alwi Farhan in a notable match at the China Open, highlighting his growing presence on the international stage.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This rule change directly impacts the development and competitive landscape for young Indian shuttlers in domestic tournaments, potentially shaping future talent.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of a 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.

title: Delhi World Championships 2026: Attracting Gen Z and Alpha Fans
indian_angle: With India hosting the World Championships in Delhi, this piece highlights efforts to grow the sport's fanbase domestically and ensure its long-term popularity among Indian youth.
summary: An article discussing the need to attract younger generations, Gen Z and Gen Alpha, to badminton, especially with the upcoming World Championships in Delhi in 2026.

title: Grassroot Coaches Development Program Underway in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This program is crucial for enhancing the quality of badminton coaching at the grassroots level across India, directly benefiting the development of future Indian talent.
summary: The BAI has initiated a Coaches Development Program at the Grassroot Level in NCE Guwahati and Raipur, running from July 15th to 24th, aimed at improving coaching standards.
